Senior & Junior Research Fellows Vacancy
Monday, 28 March 2016
8045 Hits
Title of Project:
“Maintenance of Repository for Filarial Parasites and  Reagents”
Duration of Project:
Initially for 1 year
Name of the Post:
Senior & Junior Research Fellows (One Post each)
Essential Qualification:
SRF:
M.Sc. with first class in Biochemistry / Biotechnology / Molecular Biology / Microbiology / Life Sciences and 2 years of research experience in molecular biology
JRF:
M.Sc. with first class in Biochemistry / Biotechnology / Molecular Biology / Microbiology / Life Sciences
Desirable Qualification :
NET qualified
Fellowship:
SRF:
Rs. 28000/- pm + 10 % HRA for JRF-NET qualified candidates and Rs. 18000/- pm + 10 % HRA for Lectureship-NET qualified or non-NET qualified candidates
JRF:
Rs. 25000/- pm + 10 % HRA for JRF-NET qualified candidates and Rs. 16000/- pm + 10 % HRA for Lectureship-NET qualified or non-NET qualified candidates
Application on with full bio-data along with copies of mark sheets, degree certificates and other academic credentials should be sent to Dr. MVR Reddy, Prof & Head, Department of Biochemistry, MGIMS, Sevagram (Dist. Wardha) by
email.
biochem@mgims.ac.in
on or before
30 April 2016.
After the preliminary review of the applications, the shortlisted candidates will be notified for personal interview through an e-mail. TA/DA is not admissible for attending the interview or for joining the post.
The selected candidate will be appointed on purely temporary basis, initially for a period of one year or till his / her services are required for the project or till Validity of the project, whichever is earliest.
Swachhata Pakhwada April 2024

Senior & Junior Research Fellows (One Post each)
SRF: M.Sc. with first class in Biochemistry / Biotechnology / Molecular Biology / Microbiology / Life Sciences and 2 years of research experience in molecular biology
JRF: M.Sc. with first class in Biochemistry / Biotechnology / Molecular Biology / Microbiology / Life Sciences
SRF: Rs. 28000/- pm + 10 % HRA for JRF-NET qualified candidates and Rs. 18000/- pm + 10 % HRA for Lectureship-NET qualified or non-NET qualified candidates
JRF: Rs. 25000/- pm + 10 % HRA for JRF-NET qualified candidates and Rs. 16000/- pm + 10 % HRA for Lectureship-NET qualified or non-NET qualified candidates

Application on with full bio-data along with copies of mark sheets, degree certificates and other academic credentials should be sent to Dr. MVR Reddy, Prof & Head, Department of Biochemistry, MGIMS, Sevagram (Dist. Wardha) by email. biochem@mgims.ac.in on or before 30 April 2016.

After the preliminary review of the applications, the shortlisted candidates will be notified for personal interview through an e-mail. TA/DA is not admissible for attending the interview or for joining the post.

The selected candidate will be appointed on purely temporary basis, initially for a period of one year or till his / her services are required for the project or till Validity of the project, whichever is earliest.
